detailedSolution:

Arrange the major religious teachers of the subcontinent in a chronological

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Chronology of religious teachers: (A) Appar (Tirunavukkarasar), one of the foremost Tamil Shaiva Nayanars, lived in the seventh century CE; (C) Nammalvar, the eminent Tamil Vaishnava Alvar poet, flourished in the ninth century CE; (D) Ramanujacharya, who systematized Vishishtadvaita Vedanta, lived between c. 1017 and 1137 CE; (B) Basavanna founded the Virashaiva/Lingayat movement in Karnataka in the mid-twelfth century CE. Hence, option (A) is correct.

questionText:

options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
